name: Over-the-shoulder build
brief: Angle: watch the agent assemble a launch video live. Hook: open in-product on one real high-stakes action (type the brief, hit go). Beats: hook → the board materializing → the hero result card → CTA. Leans on: capture-based dashboard scenes (real-UI-capture). OPEN QUESTION: does the dashboard expose per-step cost to show on the result card?

name: The empty timeline
brief: Angle: a blank editing timeline fills itself, beat by beat, as the VO names what each does. Hook: a benefit question over the empty canvas, product name withheld 3s. Beats: question → timeline self-fills → finished frame → CTA. Leans on: kinetic SVG cards (motion-graphics). Signature: the self-drawing playhead.

name: One prompt, one film
brief: Angle: a single typed sentence expands into the whole video in one continuous push. Hook: the recognizable UI assembling from nothing. Beats: prompt typed → continuous zoom through the pipeline → reveal the rendered film → CTA. Leans on: authored-continuous composite. Needs no external service.
